title: Can LLMs Assist Annotators in Identifying Morality Frames? - Case Study on Vaccination Debate on Social Media
reasoning: The paper evaluates the capability of LLMs to identify moral foundations and morality frames in social media discourse. This includes the 'sanctity/degradation' foundation, which the authors explicitly link to religious context and sacred values. Furthermore, the study specifically analyzes frames such as 'VaccineAgainstReligion' and religious entities like 'Christian' within its framework.
